class.name: NNBTTimeLimiter
class.brief_description: Fails its child node's run when the child has been running for longer than [member time_limit] seconds of accumulated delta.
class.description:
The time limiter node ticks its first enabled child node and watches how long the child stays running. The [code]delta[/code] of every tick whose child result is [code]RUNNING[/code] is accumulated; the limit is exceeded only when the accumulated time is strictly greater than [member time_limit]. Time is accumulated from delta only and never from the wall clock, so the limit is deterministic and pause-safe.
When the limit is exceeded the child subtree is reset, the accumulated time is cleared, and the node completes with [code]FAILURE[/code]. A [member time_limit] of [code]0[/code] or any negative value means unlimited and never times the child out; negative values are accepted unchanged and the property range hint is for authoring only. A reset rule of [code]WhenTicked[/code] clears the accumulated time on every tick, so a positive [member time_limit] can never be exceeded under that rule. An explicit reset of this node or of an ancestor, such as disabling and re-enabling the root, also clears the accumulated time.
A terminal child result passes through unchanged and completes the node immediately, so a fast [code]SUCCESS[/code] or [code]FAILURE[/code] is never altered.
The time limiter must have exactly one enabled behaviour-tree child. With no enabled child it completes with [code]FAILURE[/code].

method.name: get_time_spent
method.description: Returns the delta seconds accumulated while the child result was [code]RUNNING[/code] in the current run.

members.member: The maximum number of delta seconds the child may keep returning [code]RUNNING[/code] before the node fails. [code]0[/code] or a negative value means unlimited. The property range hint is for authoring only.
